newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-DONIZETE'S GOAL TAKES BENFICA TO THE TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DONIZETE'S GOAL TAKES BENFICA TO THE TOP.

text.p: Brazilian Osmar Donizete scored his fifth goal of the season to take Benfica to the top of the Portuguese first division on Sunday.
The 1-0 away win over Salgueiros took them two points clear of champions Porto.
Donizete, the league's top scorer, headed home a Bruno Caires cross in the 24th minute. He was denied two more goals by the width of the crossbar.
Benfica head the table with 16 points, followed by Porto on 14. Farense, 2-1 victors at home to Rio Ave in an ill-tempered encounter, Sporting and Espinho have 13.
Porto beat Sporting 1-0 away on Saturday to extend their unbeaten run against the Lisbon side to seven years.
The Farense-Rio Avenue match resulted in three visiting players being sent off. Both Farense goals came from penalties.
